# vendor/llama_quantize

Pre-built llama.cpp CPU binaries for Windows x64 (b9305).

The `.exe` and `.dll` files are gitignored (too large). Download them with:

```powershell
scripts\setup_vendor.ps1
```

Or manually: download `llama-b9305-bin-win-cpu-x64.zip` from
https://github.com/ggerganov/llama.cpp/releases/tag/b9305
and extract all files here.

`convert_hf_to_gguf.py` is checked in (Python script, 12 KB).
